reader_summary.headline: Pat Dorsey is the Founder of Dorsey Asset Management.
reader_summary.overview: Pat Dorsey is the Founder of Dorsey Asset Management. Pat created Morningstar's moat research framework and led its equity research efforts for a dozen years before launching his firm in 2014. Our conversation covers the nuances of investing in businesses with wide moats across quantitative analysis, switching costs, network effects, brands, management, alignment, capital allocation.

key_points.text: Pat Dorsey is the Founder of Dorsey Asset Management.
Our conversation covers the nuances of investing in businesses with wide moats across quantitative analysis, switching costs, network effects, brands, management, alignment, capital allocation.
We then turn to Pat's application of moat analysis to his investing, including concentration, global scope, position sizing, decision making, and lessons learned.
